nodes.label: Mobile debug reports and feedback (doc, not loaded)
Diagnostics bus is a module singleton, not React state
nodes.rationale: The session outlives every screen, must not re-render the transcript on every event, and must be writable from outside React (apiFetch, ErrorUtils, lock-screen intents).

nodes.label: Snapshot carries the refs, not just TutorSessionState
nodes.rationale: Nearly every documented session hazard lives in refs invisible to the rendered state (conversationIdRef, savedForRef, ownsRef, etc.); a snapshot without them turns a bug hunt back into a conversation.

nodes.label: Frozen at-error snapshot travels beside the live one
nodes.rationale: By the time a modal is opened minutes after an error, start()/setError(null) have already run and the live refs describe a different, healthy session.

nodes.label: Fix: journal cleared only on a final 4xx refusal
nodes.rationale: restoreParked previously cleared the journal unconditionally, discarding a transcript on any crash/network failure with no signal; isFinalRefusal now retains on everything but a 4xx, which is the sole channel of truth for an OpenAI lesson whose client write is the only witness.

nodes.label: Gate run findings: report format corrections (2026-09-09)
nodes.rationale: Two fresh readers given only pnpm report <id> surfaced five format bugs (buried error fields, causal overreach, false canned text, overconfident heuristics, misleading provider-mismatch styling), each fixed rather than left as ambiguity for the reader to resolve.
